definition: In the intervening period of time.
exampleSentence: The detective searched the study; meanwhile, his assistant interviewed the housekeeper.

definition: At a previous or earlier time; before.
exampleSentence: She realized she had previously visited that tranquil coastal hamlet during childhood.

definition: In the end, especially after a long delay or dispute.
exampleSentence: After wandering down three winding alleys, they eventually discovered the hidden courtyard.

definition: Slowly over a period of time or a distance.
exampleSentence: The morning fog gradually lifted as the autumn sun climbed over the hill.

definition: Up to the point in time or the event mentioned.
exampleSentence: The expedition waited patiently until the storm had completely subsided.

definition: Before a particular time or event.
exampleSentence: Please complete the health questionnaire prior to your clinic visit.

definition: After a particular thing has happened; afterwards.
exampleSentence: The defect was detected and subsequently remedied by senior technicians.

definition: Came before something in time, order, or position.
exampleSentence: A severe thunderstorm preceded the sudden drop in temperature.

definition: Came after something in time or sequence.
exampleSentence: A lively public debate followed the premiere of the historical play.

definition: At or before the moment when something occurs.
exampleSentence: By the time firefighters reached the warehouse, the fire had subsided.
